applies_to: Legrand 2-module DIN energy meters cat. no. 046 77 and 046 79 with RS485 (Modbus/JBUS), per the 'Communication protocol' sheet dated 01/07/2011.
summary: Legrand's 046 77 and 046 79 are two-module DIN-rail energy meters with an RS485 port speaking Modbus/JBUS. The protocol sheet lists a small set of words: voltage, current, active power with a separate sign word, power factor with its inductive/capacitive sector, frequency, total and partial active energy, run time, a reset word and a device identifier.

addressing.note: Addresses are printed in hex as sent in the request. The sheet's example reads 4 words starting at 0x200A with the frame 01 03 20 0A 00 04, and writes the reset word with 01 10 00 C8 00 01 02 00 01.

source.title: Communication protocol - 046 77 / 046 79 Energy meter 2 module
source.pages: Physical level and data format pp. 2-3; commands p. 6; variables and examples p. 7

notes: Data format (2.2): a 'long' is two words sent most significant word first, so 32-bit values are ABCD; the example answer 00 00 64 8C reads as 25740.

The sheet calls the 32-bit format just 'long' without saying signed or unsigned. Power and power factor are magnitudes with separate sign/sector words and energies only count up, so the values are listed as unsigned; any reading below 2^31 decodes the same either way.
Only functions 0x03 (read words) and 0x10 (write words) are supported. Address 0 is broadcast with no answer.
The sheet's example labels the second value read from 0x200A as 'total reactive energy', but the variables table puts positive partial active energy at 0x200C; the table is followed here.
Baud rate is programmable on the meter; the sheet gives 8 data bits and 1 stop bit but no parity or default speed.
Timing: keep gaps between characters under 100 ms; the meter answers no sooner than 25 ms.

registers.name: Active power (magnitude)
registers.description: Size only; the sign is in 0x2006.

registers.name: Power factor
registers.description: Magnitude; inductive or capacitive sector is in 0x2008.

registers.name: Reset command
registers.description: Write-only; set the bit to reset that counter.

integration.summary: Read holding registers with function 03 from 0x2000: 16 words cover voltage, current, power with its sign word, power factor, frequency, total and partial energy and run time.
integration.enable: Set the meter's Modbus address and baud rate on the device; the protocol sheet does not describe the menu.
quirks: Power is unsigned with a separate sign word (0x2006).
Voltage and current come in mV and mA.
setup: 8 data bits, 1 stop bit; baud rate programmable.
Up to 32 devices per segment without repeaters.
gotchas: The sheet lists only function 03 for reading and 0x10 for writing.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
